subject: reasoning
question:
Two positions of a dice are given below. What will come on the face opposite to the face containing '5' on it?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4155b895e9f46d2eb890297979f82bdad862323e380df91dca218fb74d6be3e5.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 6 is common on both the dice, it is clear that 2, 6, 1, and 5 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. 4 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5e2d91896f5dc2466eff4679d6355ad81a4e76170294bd101f6657c32783559.png] 

Opposite pairs:

3 → 5

2 → 1

6 → 4

So, the opposite side of "5" will be side "3".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
